metrics.volume: Average monthly searches over the last 12 months in the selected country.
metrics.kd: Difficulty (0–100): how hard it is to reach the top 10, based on referring domains to the top 10 pages.
metrics.cpc: Average Google Ads cost per click (USD).
metrics.intent: Searcher intent: informational, navigational, commercial or transactional.
metrics.traffic: Estimated monthly organic traffic: volume × CTR by position and SERP features.
metrics.credits: Credits are spent on data source requests.
metrics.competition: Google Ads competition (0–1): how many advertisers bid on the keyword.
metrics.trafficPotential: Traffic the #1 page gets from all keywords it ranks for.
metrics.parentTopic: The most searched keyword the #1 page also ranks for. Target it to cover the whole topic.
metrics.organicKeywords: Number of keywords the domain ranks for in the top 100 in the selected country.
metrics.domainRating: Backlink profile strength (0–100) from the data provider. Higher rating = easier to rank.
metrics.competitionLevel: Share of common keywords among all keywords of both domains. Higher = more direct competitor.
metrics.visibility: How many of the possible clicks you get: 100 % means #1 for every tracked keyword (weighted by volume).
metrics.avgPosition: Average position of the keywords that rank in the top 100.
metrics.shareOfVoice: Each domain's share of the expected clicks on the tracked keywords (volume × CTR by position).
metrics.volatility: How much the top 10 moved since the previous check: 0 = no change, 10 = completely new results.
metrics.spamScore: Spam score from the data provider (0–100): how spam-like the source looks.
metrics.toxicity: Our risk score (0–100) from the spam score and signals such as suspicious domains, link farms and no authority.
